title.en: Put the Land Tax in One Register

desc.zh: 在实际拥有的试点州核查田粮、官署就业与投入品短缺。可走中央清查、地方联核或有限旧额；中央路线要求现行土地/人头/比例税法基础，两次核账至少间隔三个月。条件不足时可补就业或改善供给后等待。
desc.en: Audit land tax, office staffing and input shortages in a state you actually own. Central review requires an existing land-based, per-capita or proportional taxation law; the two audits must be at least three months apart. If capacity is short, improve staffing or supply and wait.

journals.goal: { has_variable = ywc_shu_register_pilot_resolved OR = { AND = { has_variable = ywc_shu_first_audit has_variable = ywc_shu_second_audit } var:ywc_shu_pilot_outcome = 3 } }

title.en: The New Register Must Honor Old Duties

desc.zh: 将前期账务决定用于军饷、地方供役或港口商人预垫。预垫本金一年后由月度财政回调自动偿还；国库不足会持续记录逾期压力。六个月连续审查只在和平、未违约、三月债务负担比未连续恶化、试点未失且官署可用时才成熟。
desc.en: Apply the first stage to military pay, provincial service or port-merchant advances. Principal is collected by a monthly fiscal callback after one year; insolvency keeps the arrears obligation active. The six-month review matures only through uninterrupted peace, no default or bankruptcy, no three-month worsening in scaled debt burden, a retained pilot state and a ready office.

title.en: An Exemption Has Its Own History

desc.zh: 地主递上祖传免额，附有修桥、供役的旧账。军镇说若重估税额就先补军饷；县吏提醒，重征不能把同一户的徭役抹成不存在。
desc.en: Landowners present inherited exemptions with old bridge and service accounts. The garrison asks for pay before any reassessment; county clerks warn that a new tax roll does not erase duplicate labor demands.

label.zh: 成文有限免额，地方承担供役
label.en: Write a time-limited exemption with local service

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；标记地方复核权与 12 个月分担。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; records local review rights and 12 months of shared duties.

consequence_note.zh: 中央放弃部分覆盖换取地方供役和可复核期限。；地主支持提高 1 点，持续 12 个月。
consequence_note.en: The court gives up some coverage for local service and a reviewable term.; Landowners gain 1 approval for 12 months.

label.zh: 照册征收，补偿地主损失
label.en: Collect by the roll and compensate landowners

cost_note.zh: 实扣 一周收入估算基数的两倍；若行政财政不允许，不付款、不记补偿。
cost_note.en: Deduct twice the one-week income estimate; if the budget gate fails, neither payment nor compensation is recorded.

consequence_note.zh: 地主失去旧免额，获得一次补偿；反对标记留给后续核账。；实际付清后地主支持提高 2 点，持续 12 个月。
consequence_note.en: Landowners lose the exemption but receive one compensation; their objection remains in the later audit.; if paid, Landowners gain 2 approval for 12 months.

label.zh: 维持旧例，只核对边界
label.en: Keep custom and audit only its boundary

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；放弃全国税基覆盖的表述。
cost_note.en: No immediate charge; the card gives up any claim of national tax-base coverage.

consequence_note.zh: 承认受挫妥协，以有限旧额继续，仍可进入后期重议。；地主支持提高 3 点，持续 12 个月。
consequence_note.en: Accepts a bounded compromise and keeps later renegotiation open.; Landowners gain 3 approval for 12 months.

purpose.zh: 建立可撤销、有限期的免额和补偿承诺，并把旧利益传给后续节点。
purpose.en: Record bounded, reversible exemptions and compensation, carrying the distributional choice forward.

title.en: The Garrison Claims Its Share First

desc.zh: 武勋军镇把守边账与欠饷单并排放在案头。无战事也有轮值和驻防开销；地方官主张自己的税款不能被中央一笔带走。
desc.en: The military households place their border duty accounts beside their unpaid-pay petitions. Rotations and garrisons cost money even in peace; provincial officials argue that their tax share cannot simply disappear into the central chest.

label.zh: 先付首期，承诺十二期军费
label.en: Pay the first installment and commit to twelve

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_shu_military_first_payment_ready = yes } ywc_shu_pay_military_advance_once = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_military_contract_active } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_pending_event value = 1004 } } } else = { if = { limit = { ywc_shu_military_choice_unmade = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_pending_event value = 1003 } } } }

cost_note.zh: 每期为开线时周收入基数的四分之一，首期立刻支付，十二期合计三个周基数；基数为年总收入÷52，最低100。
cost_note.en: Each installment is one quarter of the opening weekly-income base; the first is paid now, and twelve total three weekly bases. The base is annual gross income ÷ 52, minimum 100.

consequence_note.zh: 须有现款且未违约、未破产、固定净收入非负。到期不足额时欠期保留，每月最多补付一期；税册退出后合同仍有效。国库拨款不等于向特定军人 POP 发薪。
consequence_note.en: Requires cash, nonnegative net fixed income, and no default or bankruptcy. Missed installments remain due and at most one is paid per monthly check, even after the fiscal arc ends. A treasury charge is not a salary transfer to an identified military POP.

label.zh: 列入预算次序，不承诺额外军心

consequence_note.zh: 税册结案及后续军制线可读取地方承担者；此选择不等于已结清军饷。
consequence_note.en: The fiscal close and later military line can read the provincial payer; this choice does not establish that garrison pay was settled.

label.zh: 沿用已登记的承担者

consequence_note.zh: 保留既有承担者；仅在原阶段缺少队列时恢复后续议事。
consequence_note.en: Keeps the recorded payer; resumes the next step only if this stage lost its queue.

label.zh: 关闭过时的军费议案
label.en: Close the outdated funding proposal

cost_note.zh: 不付款，也不变更队列。
cost_note.en: No payment or change to the queue.

consequence_note.zh: 保留当前议事与已有承诺。
consequence_note.en: Preserves the current agenda and existing commitments.

purpose.zh: 让农业税册面对具体的军饷责任，并被后续节点读取。
purpose.en: Make the agrarian tax register answer to concrete military pay obligations and carry that payer forward.

title.en: Households Written Twice

desc.zh: 一户民户的田粮记在县册，修堤和运粮又被军镇算作另一项差役。户部不能凭一桩呈状改写全国人口，但可以决定谁受理这本旧册的申诉。
desc.en: A household appears in the county tax ledger, then again in the garrison’s levee and grain-hauling service rolls. One petition cannot rewrite national population, but the Board can decide who hears the appeal.

{

ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes
	has_journal_entry = ywc_je_v03_shu_register_pilot

label.zh: 交官署复核，承担持续行政工作
label.en: Refer it to the office for a staffed review

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款；由真实行政结余与岗位供给承担持续工作。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; ongoing work must be supported by real bureaucracy and jobs.

consequence_note.zh: 中央形成复核程序，但若官署空缺，个案不会被写成已解决。
consequence_note.en: The court creates a review process; an understaffed office cannot be described as resolving the case.

label.zh: 交地方联核，保留地方裁判
label.en: Refer the petition to provincial mediation

cost_note.zh: 不即时扣款；换取地方裁判与查册权。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction; trades for local adjudication and inspection rights.

consequence_note.zh: 保护地方旧例，降低中央覆盖，并在结局保留申诉权限。
consequence_note.en: Protects provincial custom and lowers central coverage while preserving local appeals.

label.zh: 不改旧册，缩小本轮覆盖
label.en: Leave the old roll and narrow this pilot

cost_note.zh: 无即时扣款。
cost_note.en: No immediate deduction.

consequence_note.zh: 缙绅暂获稳定，重复供役问题继续留在案卷。
consequence_note.en: Gentry gain short-term stability; duplicate service remains unresolved.

purpose.zh: 具体化重复征役个案，并保证中央复核、地方调停与保守收束有不同责任人。
purpose.en: Turn duplicate service into a concrete case with distinct central, provincial and conservative responsibility.

title.en: Merchants Offer an Advance

desc.zh: 在岗港口可以提出海商预垫；没有合格港口时，有实际在岗农业地区可提出地方预缴。没有合格来源也可拒绝或缩小试点。新预垫满十二个月后在月检中收回；资金不足时保留债务和逾期政治代价。
desc.en: A staffed port can support a merchant advance; if no eligible port exists, a staffed agricultural district can propose local prepayment. Without either source the court may refuse or narrow the pilot. New principal is collected on a monthly check after twelve full months and remains a debt with a political cost if funds are insufficient.

ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes

label.zh: 接受合格来源的预垫
label.en: Accept an advance from an eligible source

cost_note.zh: 获得按一周收入估算的本金；满十二个月后在月检中偿还，国库不足则欠款保留。
cost_note.en: Receive principal based on one week of estimated income. A monthly check collects it after twelve full months when funds suffice; otherwise the debt remains.

consequence_note.zh: 须有在岗且无短缺的港口或农业建筑；后者表示地方预缴。本金不会从特定商人或人口账户扣除。
consequence_note.en: Requires a staffed port or agricultural building without a goods shortage; the latter represents local prepayment. Principal is not deducted from a specific merchant or population account.

label.zh: 拒绝预垫，不抵押后续港税
label.en: Refuse and avoid pledging future port dues

cost_note.en: No transfer and no new repayment debt.

consequence_note.zh: 中央保留未来税则空间，但失去短期商人周转银。
consequence_note.en: The court keeps future tariff freedom but loses short-term merchant liquidity.

label.zh: 缩小清查，不借外银
label.en: Narrow the audit and avoid private credit

cost_note.en: No additional audit deduction.

consequence_note.zh: 海商线不假设大顺工业化，有限旧额仍可正常结算。

label.zh: 搁置过期的预垫询问
label.en: Dismiss the stale advance inquiry

cost_note.en: No expense or principal is created.

consequence_note.zh: 保留现有队列和已记录的决定。
consequence_note.en: Keeps the existing queue and recorded decisions.

purpose.zh: 海商参与取决于真实港口，并把预垫与下一年度偿还、港税咨询连接起来。
purpose.en: Merchant participation depends on real ports and links any advance to next year’s repayment and customs consultation.

title.zh: 第二次核账，或承认久阻
title.en: The Second Audit, or a Long-Stalled Pilot

desc.zh: 两次正式核账至少相隔三个月。若三十六个月仍卡在官署、投入品或财政条件，可以承认试点受挫、转为有限旧额，不把未发生的第二次核账写成完成。
desc.en: The two formal audits must be at least three months apart. If staffing, input supply or fiscal conditions still block progress after 36 months, acknowledge a limited pilot rather than recording an audit that never happened.

label.zh: 公布中央核出的差额
label.en: Publish the centrally audited difference

cost_note.zh: 第二笔审计估算额为 一周收入估算基数的一半；财政不允许时保留待办，不记已付。
cost_note.en: Second half-installment equals half the one-week income estimate; if the budget gate fails it remains due, not paid.

consequence_note.zh: 必须满足本地官署、行政结余、纸张与两次核账；点击本身不创造税收。
consequence_note.en: Requires a local office, non-negative bureaucracy, paper availability and both audits; the button creates no tax revenue.

label.en: Wait for capacity or repayment

label.en: Pause and retain bounded old quotas

cost_note.en: Earlier payments are not refunded; no second installment is taken.

consequence_note.zh: 仅在试点仍归本国、财政安全且官署就业至少四分之一时转入限额旧额审查；仍需完成连续六个月履约。

label.zh: 撤回并保留已付款
label.en: Withdraw and retain prior payments

cost_note.zh: 不再新增费用；已付款不退。
cost_note.en: No new charges; prior payments are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 记录撤回失信并结束本线。
consequence_note.en: Record withdrawal and close this arc.

purpose.zh: 以真实条件完成第二次审查，且有中央、地方、旧额三种可结算分类。
purpose.en: Finish a second real-world check with central, provincial and legacy settlement categories.

title.en: The Provinces’ Retained Share

desc.zh: 户部要把新册上的收入用在军饷、地方供役还是海关垫款上。中央查核、地方分担、旧额封顶互相排斥，不能同时取三份好处。
desc.en: The Board must assign the new register’s claims to military pay, local service or merchant advances. Central audit, provincial sharing and capped quotas are mutually exclusive; the court cannot claim all three gains.

label.zh: 中央负责军饷与公共项目
label.en: Central court pays garrisons and public duties

cost_note.zh: 六个月观察期内须保持净固定收入非负；不追加免征法令。
cost_note.en: Maintain non-negative net fixed income for the six-month review; no tax law is granted.

consequence_note.zh: 中央查核路线继续；真实军饷与官署支出仍由预算承担。
consequence_note.en: Continues the central audit path; real pay and office costs remain on the budget.

label.zh: 地方留用一份，换共同供役
label.en: Retain a provincial share for shared service

cost_note.zh: 不退已付费用，也不延伸全国征收。

consequence_note.zh: 允许保守秩序继续，但不领取中央查核成果。

label.en: Withdraw the capped agreement before execution

consequence_note.zh: 以撤回失信结束并释放本线名额，不记作旧额结算成功。
consequence_note.en: Ends as a breach and releases the arc slot; it does not count as a successful capped-quota settlement.

purpose.zh: 把核查结果绑定军饷、地方供役与商人垫款，六个月后再验证可支付性。
purpose.en: Bind audit results to military pay, provincial service and merchant credit, then review affordability after six months.

title.en: The Register Meets War and Austerity

desc.zh: 六个月巩固期到来。平时审查净固定收入与官署投入品；真实战争、破产、预算转负或试点失地时不装作和平，改作战时限缩或信用修复。
desc.en: The six-month consolidation review arrives. In peace it checks net fixed income, offices and building inputs. Real war, default, a negative budget or loss of the pilot state moves the court to a wartime limit or credit repair instead of pretending conditions are normal.

label.zh: 和平审查：保留能支付的安排
label.en: Peace review: retain what is affordable

cost_note.zh: 不另扣款；按真实预算检查。
cost_note.en: No extra deduction; uses the actual budget.

consequence_note.zh: 条件达标才可确立，否则后续选项只能妥协或封顶。
consequence_note.en: Establishment requires real conditions; otherwise only compromise or cap can close.

consequence_note.zh: 不强迫停战；中断会清零，和平恢复且试点仍在后，重新开启完整六个月审查。
consequence_note.en: No forced peace. The interrupted review resets; once peace and the pilot state return, a fresh six-month review begins.

label.en: Withdraw and repair fiscal credibility

title.en: The Ledger That Remains

desc.zh: 结算不是一条免费加税法令。朝廷逐项确认谁核账、谁供役、海商是否垫银，和净固定收入能否支撑官署；未达到的只能按局部妥协、旧额或失信退出。
desc.en: Settlement is not a free tax law. The court records who audited, who supplied service, whether merchants advanced funds, and whether net fixed income can sustain the office. Unmet conditions permit only a limited compromise, capped custom or breach withdrawal.

title.en: Garrison Pay Compact

desc.zh: 选择并支付一份有限契约，说明军饷、任用名单由谁核验。
desc.en: Choose and pay for a bounded compact that assigns responsibility for pay and appointments.

title.en: Appointments and Garrison Supply

desc.zh: 按所选军制检查真实部队、自有兵营和官署：专业、共约与旧军分别要求兵营就业至少 80%、60%、25%，且兵营无投入品短缺；不足可等待、修复或降格。
desc.en: Check actual forces, owned barracks and administration: professional, compact and legacy routes require at least 80%, 60% and 25% barracks occupancy respectively, without barracks input shortages. Wait, repair or reduce the target when short.

title.en: The Successor Still Follows the Compact

desc.zh: 六个月连续核验和平时期的供给、任命和财政。专业路线的已到期军费若未付或账本损坏会中断审查；修复后从零观察，也可降格或撤回。
desc.en: Continuously verify peaceful supply, appointments and finances for six months. Overdue military funding or an invalid active ledger interrupts professional review; repair it to restart, or reduce the target or withdraw.

title.en: One Order, Two Seals

desc.zh: 户部带来朝廷印，军镇也拿出旧有供军文书。先定由谁核对下一份名册；这只确定谈判桌，不替任何一方授官。
desc.en: The Board brings a court seal while the garrisons produce their old supply warrants. Decide who checks the next roster; this sets the negotiating table and appoints nobody.

label.zh: 先由朝廷与铨部联署
label.en: Let court and personnel office countersign first

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 中央掌握复核权，后续专业整编的费用较低，军镇需提交完整名册。
consequence_note.en: The court keeps review authority, lowering later professional-audit cost while requiring complete garrison rosters.

label.zh: 军镇也须盖上供饷印
label.en: Require the garrisons to seal the supply record too

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 军镇取得书面复核权；后续地方共约可减免一次费用，但中央核验门槛更高。
consequence_note.en: Garrisons gain a written review role; the later local compact can waive a fee, while central verification becomes harder.

label.zh: 先封存调令，暂不签约
label.en: Seal the order without signing a compact

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 不产生新费用；进入可恢复的受阻议价，仍可重试或撤回。
consequence_note.en: No new charge; the compact enters a recoverable negotiation delay and can be retried or withdrawn.

purpose.zh: 户部带来朝廷印，军镇也拿出旧有供军文书。先定由谁核对下一份名册；这只确定谈判桌，不替任何一方授官。
purpose.en: The Board brings a court seal while the garrisons produce their old supply warrants. Decide who checks the next roster; this sets the negotiating table and appoints nobody.

title.en: Unpaid Garrisons, Vacant Offices

desc.zh: 两本名册都不完整：军户称旧欠未清，铨部称候补官缺无人交接。玩家可以先核实一笔有限账目，也可把责任压回地方或承认旧额上限。
desc.en: Both rosters are incomplete: garrison households cite arrears, while the personnel office has vacant posts. Verify one bounded ledger, assign responsibility locally, or cap the legacy obligation.

label.zh: 先核一笔军饷与官缺账
label.en: Audit one payroll and vacancy ledger

cost_note.zh: 按年总收入÷52（最低100）收取一次核验费；必须财政安全且有现款。
cost_note.en: One audit fee equal to annual gross income ÷ 52 (minimum 100); requires safe finances and available reserves.

consequence_note.zh: 只有扣款成功才可进入保荐名单；既有欠款仍按账承担。
consequence_note.en: Only a successful charge advances to recommendations; existing arrears remain due.

label.zh: 由各道先报实额
label.en: Ask the provinces to report actual amounts first

cost_note.zh: 无新增中央费用；须承担地方报告权，并在后续至少核验实际官署就业。
cost_note.en: No central fee; accepts provincial reporting rights and a later check of real administration employment.

consequence_note.zh: 走地方共约时地方拥有账目复核权，中央不能同时按全额统一军额结案。
consequence_note.en: A local compact gives provinces review rights; the court cannot also settle as if it held the full centralized roster.

label.zh: 承认有限旧额，不追补全部欠饷
label.en: Keep a limited legacy allowance without claiming all arrears

cost_note.zh: 不收核验费；目标降低，不能声称已清偿未付军饷。
cost_note.en: No audit fee; the target is smaller and unpaid military arrears are not declared cleared.

consequence_note.zh: 保留旧指挥与较低供给目标，后续兵营就业门槛较低但中央整编收益也较少。
consequence_note.en: Preserves legacy command at a lower supply target; later barracks employment threshold and centralization benefit are both lower.

purpose.zh: 两本名册都不完整：军户称旧欠未清，铨部称候补官缺无人交接。玩家可以先核实一笔有限账目，也可把责任压回地方或承认旧额上限。
purpose.en: Both rosters are incomplete: garrison households cite arrears, while the personnel office has vacant posts. Verify one bounded ledger, assign responsibility locally, or cap the legacy obligation.

title.en: A Commander's Recommendation List

desc.zh: 将领递上荐任名单，铨部要求每一缺额都有可追溯的交接。军方保荐、文武会核与仅承认现任各有不同权责。
desc.en: A commander submits recommendations; the personnel office wants each vacancy to have a traceable handover. Military nomination, joint review and recognition of incumbents assign different powers.

label.zh: 军职按资格逐名核验
label.en: Audit military appointments by qualification

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 专业整编须有职业军制或在役兵营实际达到较高就业；军方失去单独保荐权。
consequence_note.en: Professional reorganization requires professional-army law or high actual barracks employment; commanders lose sole nomination authority.

label.zh: 铨部与军镇共同签名
label.en: Have personnel office and garrisons sign together

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 承认地方共约与双重复核；官署和兵营均须证明有人履职。
consequence_note.en: Recognizes a local compact and dual review; both administration and barracks must show staffed posts.

label.zh: 暂认现任，不扩大荐任权
label.en: Recognize incumbents without expanding nominations

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 只维持可核验的现有军额；较低目标保留军镇权威，不产生新任命。
consequence_note.en: Maintains only verifiable existing strength; the lower target preserves garrison authority and creates no appointments.

purpose.zh: 将领递上荐任名单，铨部要求每一缺额都有可追溯的交接。军方保荐、文武会核与仅承认现任各有不同权责。
purpose.en: A commander submits recommendations; the personnel office wants each vacancy to have a traceable handover. Military nomination, joint review and recognition of incumbents assign different powers.

title.zh: 按营交验还是按镇包供
title.en: Audit by Barracks or Contract by Garrison

desc.zh: 三种军制各有一份不同账目。专业整编要求职业军制或真实营额与高就业；军镇共约依现行法令并承担地方核验；封顶旧军降低目标且保留既有指挥。
desc.en: Each military arrangement carries a different ledger. Professional reorganization requires professional-army law or well-staffed barracks; a garrison compact uses current law with provincial review; capped legacy strength lowers the target and preserves existing command.

label.zh: 签专业整编：逐营交验
label.en: Sign professional reorganization: audit each barracks

cost_note.zh: 一次性费用按年总收入÷52计，现行职业军制或已达目标的兵营可减半；需有现款。
cost_note.en: One-time cost is annual gross income ÷ 52; existing professional-army law or already-qualified barracks halves it; cash reserves are required.

consequence_note.zh: 须检查真实兵营、官署岗位与供给；已签中央军费的到期欠款或损坏账本会中断专业继任审查，未到期款无需提前付。
consequence_note.en: Checks real barracks, office posts and supply; overdue installments or an invalid active central-funding ledger interrupt professional succession review. Future installments need not be prepaid.

cost_note.zh: 此前已承认地方报账、共同复核，或地方供军税权且试点仍为本国所有时，免中央核验费；否则收取开线周收入基数的四分之一，须有现款。

consequence_note.zh: 沿用既有地方供军税权时保留地方报告权；免收中央费用不表示地方账户已付款。
consequence_note.en: Existing provincial supply rights retain local reporting authority; waiving the central fee does not assert a cash payment from a provincial account.

label.zh: 照契约结案并保留继任复核
label.en: Settle by the compact and retain successor review

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 按专业任命、地方约定或限额旧制记录实际结局；只写入结局类别，不另给军事或派系修正，也不改法律或增兵。
consequence_note.en: Records whether professional appointments, a local compact or capped legacy strength met its route; the outcome is recorded without a new military or faction modifier, law change or troops.

label.zh: 条件曾中断，恢复后重新观察
label.en: Conditions were interrupted; restart after recovery

consequence_note.en: Clears maturity and restarts a fresh six-month continuous review.

label.en: Withdraw unpaid duties while keeping signed bills

consequence_note.zh: 仅停止未发生的后续义务；已付费用、已签债务和已落实岗位不撤销。
consequence_note.en: Stops only future unpaid duties; paid fees, signed debts and appointments already made remain.

label.en: Keep the route and wait for recovery

cost_note.en: No immediate charge; arrears and signed obligations remain due.

consequence_note.zh: 等待真实条件恢复后，才可重新观察六个月。
consequence_note.en: A new six-month review can begin after the real conditions recover.

participants: 依现行法律受限的贸易群体

title.en: Port and Treasury Reconciliation

desc.zh: 在实际港口与现行贸易/税务法律下复核关账、商议分成或有限旧包征；缺港时缩小目标，欠款仍留在账上。
desc.en: Verify unified customs, negotiated revenue sharing or a capped legacy collection at a real port and under current trade and taxation laws; reduce the goal if no port exists, and keep debts on the ledger.

title.zh: 一笔港税的三个收款人
title.en: Three Claimants to One Port Duty

desc.zh: 官署、港商和地方各执一张收据。选择统一关账、商议分成或旧包税上限；若本国无港，改为内地账簿缩限或退出。
desc.en: The administration, merchants and province each hold a receipt. Choose unified books, negotiated shares or a legacy cap; without a national port, narrow this to an inland ledger or withdraw.

label.zh: 拟统一关账，由官署核验
label.en: Propose unified customs under the administration

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 记录本项责任，后续按实际条件复核。
consequence_note.en: Records this responsibility for a later check against actual conditions.

label.zh: 商议分成，保留商人查账权
label.en: Negotiate a share and retain merchant review

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 商人咨询权与分成义务登记，之后不能又按中央全额收款结案。
consequence_note.en: Records merchant review and a revenue share; the arc cannot later settle as if the court collected all revenue.

label.zh: 暂留旧包征，先封定上限
label.en: Keep the legacy collection under a fixed cap

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 目标降为现有港务与账册，不宣称统一海关或新增贸易。
consequence_note.en: Limits the goal to existing port operations and ledgers; claims neither unified customs nor new trade.

label.zh: 没有可核港口，缩为内地账房
label.en: No port can be audited; narrow to inland books

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 只核现有官署收支，不声称港税或贸易已存在。
consequence_note.en: Checks only existing administrative receipts and costs; claims no port duty or trade that is absent.

label.zh: 无港也无账可缩，撤回本线
label.en: No port or usable ledger; withdraw

cost_note.zh: 不收费；已签旧债继续保留。
cost_note.en: No fee; previously signed debts remain due.

consequence_note.zh: 释放本线槽位并记录撤回。
consequence_note.en: Releases this arc slot and records withdrawal.

purpose.zh: 官署、港商和地方各执一张收据。选择统一关账、商议分成或旧包税上限；若本国无港，改为内地账簿缩限或退出。
purpose.en: The administration, merchants and province each hold a receipt. Choose unified books, negotiated shares or a legacy cap; without a national port, narrow this to an inland ledger or withdraw.

title.en: Inland Auditors Arrive at Customs

desc.zh: 内地核账官要求对照港税、官署支出和前期税册结果。中央清查成功可降低统一路线门槛；地方分账或旧额封顶则保留相应责任。
desc.en: Inland auditors compare port duties, office costs and the earlier tax-register result. A successful central audit can lower the unified-route threshold; local sharing or a legacy cap keeps its own duties.

label.zh: 公布同一套关账簿
label.en: Publish one set of customs books

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 中央核账旧结果可减半后续核验费；若旧线为地方分担，必须保留地方复核权。
consequence_note.en: A prior central-audit result halves the later fee; a prior local-share result requires continued provincial review.

label.zh: 分开登记地方留用部分
label.en: Record the provincial share separately

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 保留地方留用与商人复核，不能套用中央全额收益。
consequence_note.en: Retains provincial share and merchant review; cannot claim full central revenue.

label.zh: 保留旧账但限制征额
label.en: Keep old books with a capped assessment

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 旧线保守结局可降低费用，但必须降低后续港务目标。
consequence_note.en: A conservative prior outcome lowers cost but also requires a smaller port target.

purpose.zh: 内地核账官要求对照港税、官署支出和前期税册结果。中央清查成功可降低统一路线门槛；地方分账或旧额封顶则保留相应责任。
purpose.en: Inland auditors compare port duties, office costs and the earlier tax-register result. A successful central audit can lower the unified-route threshold; local sharing or a legacy cap keeps its own duties.

title.en: What Will the Merchants Advance?

desc.zh: 海商提出一笔有本金、有到期日的短垫，只能用于实际账房核对；也可只给咨询权或拒绝借款。没有真实港务基础时不得伪造商人预付款。
desc.en: Merchants offer a short advance with principal and a due date for real bookkeeping only; the court may instead grant review rights or refuse credit. No advance is invented without actual port operations.

label.zh: 接受短垫，十二个月后偿还本金
label.en: Accept a short advance and repay principal after twelve months

cost_note.en: Principal is the opening weekly-income base (annual gross income ÷ 52, minimum 100); requires an eligible port, nonnegative net fixed income, and no default or bankruptcy. Monthly checks repay after twelve full months when funds permit.

consequence_note.zh: 本金增加国库并留下同额债务；不声称从具体商人或人口账户扣款。结案或撤回后仍须偿还。
consequence_note.en: Principal enters the treasury with an equal debt; no debit from an identified merchant or POP account is claimed. The debt remains after settlement or withdrawal.

label.zh: 拒绝借款，只接受有偿查账
label.en: Refuse credit and pay only for ledger review

cost_note.zh: 一次性审阅费为周收入（年总收入÷52）一半；无借款本金或未来偿还。
cost_note.en: One-time review fee is half of weekly income (annual gross income ÷ 52); no borrowed principal or future repayment.

consequence_note.zh: 扣款成功后才取得商人查账权。
consequence_note.en: Merchant review rights are recorded only after successful payment.

label.zh: 拒绝垫款，不承担借款
label.en: Refuse the advance and take no loan

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 不新增现金或债务；商人不获得咨询权，核账由官署或地方自行负担。
consequence_note.en: Adds neither cash nor debt; merchants receive no review right, and the court or province bears audit work.

label.zh: 重新商议旧版尚未答复的预垫
label.en: Reopen an unanswered legacy credit offer

cost_note.zh: 不付款、不借款；仅重送议案。
cost_note.en: No payment or loan; only requeue the proposal.

consequence_note.zh: 旧版没有阶段标记时，先重新显示选择。
consequence_note.en: When the legacy stage marker is missing, display the choice again.

label.zh: 关闭过时的海关预垫议案
label.en: Close the outdated port credit offer

cost_note.zh: 不付款；通知期间保留本阶段待办。
cost_note.en: No payment; preserves this stage while a notice is pending.

consequence_note.zh: 不改写其他阶段的队列或已签债务。
consequence_note.en: Does not overwrite another stage or an existing debt.

purpose.en: Merchants offer a short advance with principal and a due date for real bookkeeping only; the court may instead grant review rights or refuse credit. No advance is invented without actual port operations.

title.en: Prohibited Goods Still Appear on the Ledger

desc.zh: 账上出现受限商品条目，不等于贸易已获准。选择按现行贸易法与消费税法复核、缩小到账册核对，或停下等待立法系统变化。
desc.en: Restricted goods appearing in a ledger do not mean trade is permitted. Review under current trade and consumption-tax laws, narrow the audit to books, or wait for the lawmaking system to change.

label.zh: 按现行贸易法与税法核验
label.en: Verify under current trade and tax law

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 贸易法律决定可核的贸易范围，税法决定现有税单范围；不自动开放贸易。
consequence_note.en: Trade law limits auditable trade and tax law limits existing receipts; neither opens trade automatically.

label.zh: 只核账簿，不判禁货是否合法
label.en: Audit books without changing restricted-goods policy

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 缩小目标为行政账簿；法律不变，也不把禁货列作已征得的新税。
consequence_note.en: Narrows the target to administrative books; law remains unchanged and restricted goods do not become newly taxed.

label.zh: 暂缓海关承诺，等待依法变更
label.en: Defer the customs pledge until law changes through normal process

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 不要求立法系统立即通过；可持续等待或从日志内退出。
consequence_note.en: Does not force an immediate law change; the journal can wait or withdraw.

purpose.zh: 账上出现受限商品条目，不等于贸易已获准。选择按现行贸易法与消费税法复核、缩小到账册核对，或停下等待立法系统变化。
purpose.en: Restricted goods appearing in a ledger do not mean trade is permitted. Review under current trade and consumption-tax laws, narrow the audit to books, or wait for the lawmaking system to change.

title.en: Ships Enter, Money Does Not

desc.zh: 船只在港不等于税款已经入库。选择付款核验、补登记地方份额或等待，只有满足财政可负担性和实际港务才推进。
desc.en: A ship in harbor does not mean its duty reached the treasury. Pay for verification, register the provincial share, or wait; progress requires affordability and real port operations.

label.zh: 付款核验实收与欠账
label.en: Pay to verify receipts and arrears

cost_note.zh: 一次性费用为一周收入；失败不写核验标记，也不推进。
cost_note.en: One-time fee equals weekly income; failure sets no verification flag and makes no progress.

consequence_note.zh: 真实港口、官署供给、无违约/破产并有现款时才可选。
consequence_note.en: Requires a real port, administrative supply, no default or bankruptcy, and available cash.

label.zh: 先记地方留用与未收欠款
label.en: Record the provincial share and unpaid arrears first

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 有限旧册路线可直接登记；统一或共有路线未实缴核验费时返回1022补缴，欠款仍留账，缴费后重新观察180日。
consequence_note.en: The limited legacy route can register directly. Unpaid unified or shared routes return to 1022 for the actual fee; arrears remain owed, and payment starts a fresh 180-day review.

label.zh: 款项未到，先留在待核状态
label.en: Receipts have not arrived; keep the ledger pending

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 记录本项责任，后续按实际条件复核。
consequence_note.en: Records this responsibility for a later check against actual conditions.

purpose.zh: 船只在港不等于税款已经入库。选择付款核验、补登记地方份额或等待，只有满足财政可负担性和实际港务才推进。
purpose.en: A ship in harbor does not mean its duty reached the treasury. Pay for verification, register the provincial share, or wait; progress requires affordability and real port operations.

title.en: The Fee on Two Customs Forms

desc.zh: 港务人员给出中央关单与商议分成两种实际格式。决定谁承担收费、谁能查账；前序军镇共约和旧税册责任改变复核资格。
desc.en: Port officials present central and revenue-share forms. Decide who pays and who can review; earlier garrison and fiscal responsibilities change review eligibility.

label.zh: 按中央统一关单
label.en: Use the unified central form

cost_note.zh: 既有中央税册结果可免此处再次收取核验费；否则一次性收取。
cost_note.en: A prior central fiscal-register result waives this second audit fee; otherwise a one-time fee applies.

consequence_note.zh: 官署须真实供给，且统一路线承担完整中央核验义务。
consequence_note.en: Requires actual administration supply and full central review under the unified route.

label.zh: 商议分成并留商人查账权
label.en: Negotiate a share and retain merchant review

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 军镇共约或旧税册地方分担支持此路线；否则承担一次有偿协商费用。
consequence_note.en: A prior garrison compact or fiscal local-share result supports this route; otherwise a one-time negotiation cost applies.

label.zh: 限制旧包征，不追求全面关账
label.en: Cap the legacy collection instead of full customs

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 目标降低，只核现有收款和季节性支出，不获得统一征收收益。
consequence_note.en: Lowers the target to current receipts and seasonal costs, without unified-collection benefits.

purpose.zh: 港务人员给出中央关单与商议分成两种实际格式。决定谁承担收费、谁能查账；前序军镇共约和旧税册责任改变复核资格。
purpose.en: Port officials present central and revenue-share forms. Decide who pays and who can review; earlier garrison and fiscal responsibilities change review eligibility.

title.en: Sharing the Burden in the Off-season

desc.zh: 淡季港务收入可能下降，但官署供给、商人本金和分成责任仍持续。选择由中央承担、按既有协议分担或缩小承诺，并开始连续六个月交验。
desc.en: Off-season port receipts may fall while administrative costs, merchant principal and sharing duties continue. Choose central payment, existing shared terms or a reduced commitment, then begin six months of review.

label.zh: 中央按账承担当前港务费
label.en: The court pays current port costs

cost_note.en: Legacy books waive the one-time fee; unified customs requires cash. Any fiscal or port interruption resets observation.

consequence_note.zh: 启动连续六个月观察，财政恶化、战事或港口失去会清除成熟资格。
consequence_note.en: Starts a continuous six-month review; worsening finances, war or port loss clears maturity.

label.en: Reduce to seasonal review of the capped legacy amount

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 目标和收益均降低；既有借款到期仍须偿还。
consequence_note.en: Both target and benefit are smaller; existing advances remain repayable.

label.en: Withdraw from this port reform

cost_note.en: No further fee; existing advances and arrears remain due.

consequence_note.zh: 释放本轮名额并记录撤回，不视为港务结案成功。
consequence_note.en: Frees the slot and records withdrawal without counting as a successful port settlement.

label.en: Restore eligibility and restart the six-month review

consequence_note.en: Settlement remains unavailable until 180 continuous qualifying days have passed again.

cost_note.en: No charge; existing debts are unchanged.

consequence_note.en: Keep the unfinished step and wait for eligibility; if books are recorded and credit remains unanswered, redeliver that choice.

purpose.zh: 淡季港务收入可能下降，但官署供给、商人本金和分成责任仍持续。选择由中央承担、按既有协议分担或缩小承诺，并开始连续六个月交验。
purpose.en: Off-season port receipts may fall while administrative costs, merchant principal and sharing duties continue. Choose central payment, existing shared terms or a reduced commitment, then begin six months of review.

title.en: The Treasury Cannot Depend on One Port

desc.zh: 连续六个月的关账期满，复核贸易法律、真实港口、官署供给和财政。结案不提前偿还预垫本金；到期后国家月检继续追偿。
desc.en: After six months of customs review, recheck trade law, real ports, administrative supply and finances. Settlement does not repay the advance early; country monthly checks continue collection after maturity.

label.zh: 统一关账结案
label.en: Settle unified customs

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 仅统一路线、真实港口、法律与岗位持续达标且观察成熟可结案；登记官署整账，效果偏中央。
consequence_note.en: Requires unified route, real port, sustained legal and staffing conditions and a mature review; records centralized bookkeeping.

label.zh: 分成与查账权共同结案
label.en: Settle negotiated sharing and review

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 保留地方/商人份额，收益低于中央统一关账但更符合已有分担。
consequence_note.en: Retains provincial and merchant shares; yields less than unified customs but honors recorded responsibilities.

label.zh: 封顶旧账结案
label.en: Settle capped legacy books

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 只承认现有收款与较低目标；保留旧集团支持，不称全面统一海关。
consequence_note.en: Recognizes existing receipts and a smaller target; retains conservative group support without claiming unified customs.

label.zh: 返回协商账式，补齐分成条款
label.en: Revisit the ledger form and complete sharing terms

cost_note.zh: 不退还已付费用，不免除既有借款，也不新增本金。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and existing debts remain; no new principal is issued.

consequence_note.zh: 返回账式协商；补齐查账权与地方份额后重新连续观察六个月，不直接取得结案资格。
consequence_note.en: Return to form negotiation. Complete review rights and local shares, then begin a new six-month observation; this does not grant settlement.

label.zh: 条件中断，修复后从零观察
label.en: Conditions broke; repair and restart observation

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 清除成熟资格；恢复实际港务和财政后重新连续观察六个月。
consequence_note.en: Clears maturity; after port operations and finances recover, a new six-month continuous review begins.

label.zh: 撤回未付关务承诺
label.en: Withdraw unpaid customs duties

cost_note.zh: 不收费。
cost_note.en: No charge.

consequence_note.zh: 已签商人本金、地方份额和已付款项不会消失；只终止未付未来责任。
consequence_note.en: Merchant principal, provincial shares and paid costs remain; only unpaid future duties end.

purpose.zh: 连续六个月的关账期满，复核贸易法律、真实港口、官署供给、欠款和财政。可按实际路线结案；未成熟、战争、失州或财政恶化时仍可重试、缩限或退出。
purpose.en: Six months of customs review have passed. Recheck trade law, real ports, administrative supply, debt and finances. Settle only the route actually fulfilled; if interrupted by war, lost territory or worsening finances, retry, narrow or withdraw.
